column1: # VM fingerprints: what the Book says, and what is reported for Epic's new Verse VM (unverified).

column5: Epic's Verse VM prints function returning|returned|branch body finished|branch cleanup|after wait (UEFN 43.12, CL-60598086): a branch runs until its parent task ends; the Blueprint VM prints the Book's lines. OpenVerse follows the Verse VM since #724.

Epic's Verse VM lets the branch outlive the function and prints branch received 7 inside the Signal, before signaled (UEFN 43.12); the Blueprint VM prints the Book's lines. OpenVerse follows the Verse VM since #724.
